title: Customer availability and timing notes
summary: This topic is dominated by service-note fragments about customers being unavailable or discussing timing, with only one clear complaint about a poorly timed lane change.

negative.summary: The only clear negative example describes the vehicle changing lanes at a bad moment.

undetermined.summary: Most fragments are administrative notes about customers being busy, away from the vehicle, or discussing the current moment without a clear opinion of the vehicle.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined service or scheduling notes rather than clear vehicle feedback.
